rapport_notes: Patient, walked through billing mechanics clearly and calmly, handled repeat/re-explain requests well.

evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer had multiple billing questions (minimum hours, trip fee, per-15-minute rate) and a piano/stairs worry; rep answered each fully, ending with the customer saying 'that is super helpful.'

top_strength: Patiently and clearly walked through the billing mechanics (minimum, 15-min increments, trip fee) point by point until the caller, who was relaying info to a decision-maker, fully understood.
coaching_note: Never gave a personalized time/cost anchor for the actual move — only explained the billing mechanics; a 'typical move like yours takes X-Y hours' statement would have given the caller something concrete to relay to his mom.
